body:
Five weeks. That's the whole Harry Styles chapter — December 2012 to January 7, 2013.

And those five weeks somehow gave us three of 1989's shiniest songs: "Style," "Out of the Woods," and "I Know Places." The shortest romance on her whole map, and it fed an entire era 😭

So here's the impossible one: "Style" or "Out of the Woods"? The one that struts, or the one that can't catch its breath? Pick ONE and defend it below — and tag the friend who's about to pick wrong 🤍

Every relationship-to-song map like this lives in Blank Spaces, our thread tracing which chapter each song came out of.
